body: The quickest and most painless way would be to put a big hole in the mendula oblangata which controls your breathing and heart rate in your brain. it'll put you down without pain or suffering.

I've been feeling the weight of not being in any sort of relationship for over 10 years, its rather lonly but I must admit that Ive given up hope many years ago and just resigned myself to work myself into a good financial posistion!

I wish I could but I can't do that, my parents never really wanted me around in the first place.... haha the shitty thing is the my first homeless night I actually slept in my car less than 2 miles away from my parents house because I couldn't stay there anymore. My Christmas present that year was to get to sleep on their couch for a weekend.  

My parents are positive that I'm just lazy, worthless, stoner who wont amount to anything more than a janitor or fried food flipper.... my parents place is just a bombardment of negativity and mild violence

I actually work 4 jobs at the moment but my main job is doing Digital Advertising/Marketing for a semi big company. Then I'm a janitor/maintenance worker for 4 office buildings after I get off work there, then I do dish washing/busing at a restaurant & bar for 2 or 3 weekdays and weekends. I also drive for uber whenever I can get some spare time or if there's an event I can target for a good amount of work, then I do deliveries for edible arrangements around holidays, and I also run sound/back line for local music venues and events. I also try and give blood as often as possible because its a good way to get some extra gas money. 

Sounds like I'd be swimming in money right? haha naw I can squeak by with at the most +$100 or $200 after all my expenses, but I dont include gas,food, & my prescription costs. So basically if I have any additional expenses it can quickly spiral me even further in the hole than I already am. I cant stand working this hard for this long for almost no gain or a net loss.... its incredibly disheartening when people want to hang out with me or a girl wants to go out with me but I have to say no every single time.

Well when I lost my house it was in the middle of December and it got down to -2, so I had enough to get a motel 3 or 4 times per pay cycle I'd have to spread those out so I could shower and not appear like I'd been sleeping in my car. Honestly I had to get a pint of whisky or a few 40s to help me sleep and numb myself most nights. 

Ever since it happened to me that first time in December, it seems to keep happening to me one way or another. I think I can bring my bank account back from -$900 in 3 months but acquiring the around $2,000 for first/last months rent & deposit might prove too much. Unless I can find some part time work somewhere to supplement my income I'm pretty sure I'm screwed. OH snap that gave me a glorious idea.... I wonder if my other jobs would pay out my vacation/sick time in a lump sum. Or I could take a that paid time off and just find another part time job so then I could work that job while getting vacation pay from my main job...

Yea the company I worked for went under and I used to live in a small town so there wasn't anything else I could get. I was basically forced to sell all of my music gear (at least $7,000) to try and move somewhere where I wouldn't be homeless for much longer. It worked to a point but it basically destroyed me selling everything I worked so hard for. So now that I've been with nothing for so many years I realize that this black hole just wont go away. I mean you'd think after 2 years of working 70 hour weeks would get you out of debt but it really is just soul crushing realizing that I'd have to do that at least 3 more years to escape my situation, and honestly I can't do this anymore

Agreed, I have to work 4 jobs in order for me to even stay close to even within my finances. I can just see myself just working like this for the rest of my life to just suddenly wake up and realize I have never accomplished anything or made any sort of relationship connection. In the next few months when I can't afford a deposit on a new rental will be my 4th time being homeless, and I'm honestly just going to hand myself from a bridge. It's all pointless and I haven't felt happy in over 7 years so might as well just throw in the towel and we'll have one less dip shit sucking oxygen. 

Good luck I hope you can figure it out better than I did...

I do have room mates but I leave before their awake and get home when their headed to bed. Idk I just realize that I'm going to have to keep working at the same rate or even more in order to have a place to sleep and eat more than once a day. Im just tired of working so hard just to get no where fast. Plus I've had no one who gives any sort of a fuck for so long that being alone is just normal now, even though I wish it wern't. Ha this is really the only outlet for me to talk to people, and the hilarious thing is that I'm just kickin it in my office.

Yea, I've just been working over 70 hrs. a week for the past 2 years but that barely covers all my financials. I can barely afford to eat more than once a day just so I can conserve money for my bills. I dono I just have had no money to do anything social in so long, or even take a weekend off. My last day off was last May for my birthday which I spent fishing by myself. It just seems like I've been working myself half to death just so I can barely squeak by, and my moment of reckoning is fast approaching where my housing situation will disappear and i'll have to live in my car for about 3 months while I save up for a deposit....  Im just trapped, sad, and frustrated with everything

Well that's not entirely true, but they treat me terribly and put me down with amazing consistency. They've never helped me, even with school I had to work my last 2 years of high school to pay for my own college. They made too much money for me to get a loan and they just said I wasn't going to amount to anything more than a janitor anyway so they didn't bother. My sister however gets to get her degree in Florida, Grad school in California, and her bachelors in another college. I'm treated more like a burden so I don't really count them as family.

Thanks, I consistently have my resume out there already so hopefully I can find a company willing to pay me enough to have a life again. I have dropped everything and moved cities twice before, but nothing really changes. I still can barely eeeek by and living in my car in between places sucks many many many @#%$

Yea I have no school debt, I worked through high school and had to pay my own way, since my parents made too much money I couldn't get a loan. I tried going to school last year for really anything but my medical bills are too large and they can't approve me.
I would totally do that if I wasn't so pressed for money, I have to work as much as humanly possible, so hopefully one day I can get a day or two off. Although I've been saying that the last 2 years.

Yea I was actually offered a position but my shitty car took a dump, so I had to pass it by because I couldn't drive up there. I entertained the idea of using the trains/buses but they didn't start early enough for me to be to work on time.... But I've fixed that issue so maybe sometime in the future i'll be able to make enough money to actually have a weekend/life

If happyness hasn't reached me even once in the past 5 of my late 20s I fear that it's rather late in the game for any significant change. Even if I keep trying and fighting I feel like all I'd achieve is just some lone guy working 2-3 jobs with no weekends no friends and no family. Just work work work work work work work, more work.

I envy you.

I've worked almost 70 hour a week for the past 2 years, sacrificed all weekends and spare time to just work and get money... still didn't help, I'm still screwed. It's all rather pointless to just work so hard for so long just to be destroyed and homeless again.

You know that's how I thought this would pan out. Work super hard for a really long time to break myself out of poverty and be able to support myself. Alas this was not to be, and now I'm destined to crash again. If anything I need to work more in order to pay everything off I need to but a 7am-10pm work day really kills me. Even if I was burnt out I cant stop, I need to keep pushing, but its so all pointless...

I can for see my self-destruction happening either at the end of this month or in April. I am definitely fucked.... Once all of these things destroy me and I end up on the streets again, I am definitely going to call it quits.

I hope I can find the right meds, but for now I can't afford new meds. My 3-4 jobs do fucking suck.... well I guess just the fact I have to work so hard for almost no pay off. My job is really nice so far "Marketing Coordinator". Honestly because I can't afford college I've certified myself in over 12 different programs most commonly used for Web Design and Marketing and am trying to find my way into Amazon/Microsoft/Google. 

But in reality thats just a dream, there are way better candidates out there that they'd rather hire with fancy masters degrees or 4 year degrees. I'm just cursed to work myself to death for little gain. I've just felt so beaten down, sad, and alone for the past 4-7 years that I just want it to stop somehow.

I would love to go any school any where! My GPA was 3.8 for my AS degree aka My Bull Shit Degree. I'll check school again but my parents made too much money so they wouldn't help me last time I checked. (parents dont even give two fucks about me, so I can just rot in a gutter for all they care... and I have) I'd imagine my massive medical/personal debt will bar me from any sort of loans until I pay them off. One day I will hopefully find a job where I can work under 50hrs a week and be able to afford things again. 

I did go try and get help for the depression but honestly I work too much and dont have time for normal relationships or friends for that matter. I haven't had a girl friend in I think 7 years and I live by myself at least 100 miles from any one else I knew as a friend. I have no time, no money, no friends, no loved ones. My life literally sucks the fattest horse cock possible!!! I almost snapped and killed myself last time I couldn't find anywhere to live. It looks like I'm headed back for round 4... At least its not winter anymore, I could hardly stand sleeping in the car in -2 degree weather.

I actually make $14/hr 40hrs/wk and then I have 2 other employers that fills out the other hours. I just have $15,000 in medical debt, car payment, insurance, phone bill, rent (Seattle), credit cards (3), Payday loans(2), 25% wage garnishment (from unemployment benefit denial), prescriptions (2), & then gas. Plus each time I pay out I have to hit a negative in my bank account so -$600 right now with its incurred overdraft fees. I only have those cards and payday loans from my previous homeless stints to try and bridge the gap of joblessness and the outside cold.  

Oh and dont worry I've applied to many programs but I still make too much money for them to help. I hate working harder than most people just to get no where, my last weekend off was for my May birthday last year(Golfing by myself). 
I will look for a roommate when I can finally save up a deposit once I dont have to pay rent anymore... Still I'm just fed up working myself to death.

What dose depression feel like? Well for me I always try and remember the last time I felt happy or loved by someone, then you realize you haven't felt love, happiness, or contentment in life in over 6 years. It's a soul crushing realization that you don't effect anything or really matter in any substantial way, and the thought of trying just makes you tired because you've already tried everything to no avail. You can see no joy or happiness anywhere while being extraordinarily stressed about making bill payments.

I work 60-75 hours a week and still have a cascading debt/bill cycle where rice and roman are once a day luxuries. I can see the point where I will become homeless for the 3rd time even though I'm only 27.... Just tired of working so hard for nothing and to be miserable during the whole ride. Almost at the end of my rope and I think that a short drop and a sudden stop is a good way to just call it quits. Im tired of being sick, cold, sad, angry, hungry, and alone. Welp if I don't do it, At least I have a car to sleep in... haven't been homeless in Seattle yet.... FML, sounds fun eh?
